description:
## [2.9.0](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/compare/v2.8.0...v2.9.0) (2026-10-27)

### Bug Fixes

* **extensions:** guard typed-preference reads against wrong-typed values ([3f248b8](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/3f248b8d69e723a844c5e93636ad41a7e8b1e0bd))
* **tiktok:** apply views and likes filters to Following and search ([32a08f3](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/32a08f3aa1717fae8340f16214bec5d062c5fd81))
* **tiktok:** hide ads between a profile's videos ([c9dd34a](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/c9dd34ac230e10161f3cfdb9ca2340f608da4a03))
* **tiktok:** keep vibration permission so sound pages no longer crash on tap ([70e63db](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/70e63dbabb27bfc2ae55f19a447dbf2a1e0446c3))
* **tiktok:** pass the activity to the refresh-rate hook on Tutor restore ([2985ced](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/2985ced5fa731940358a6a15a30ea50499f10fcc))
* **tiktok:** re-derive VideoAdaptionResult translations in fit mode ([6bcb3ba](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/6bcb3baff65f7047e505117f06ccdd383cb18484))
* **tiktok:** restore bottom navigation declutter on 47.5.3 ([5df3df7](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/5df3df76183b93eeeb8e8b4ede8cde093f2d4455))
* **tiktok:** restore device privacy guard on 47.5.3 ([96c66c9](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/96c66c960fa0ca2039d1aa5f3d0fb4f347fee0d8))
* **tiktok:** restore friends feed api hook on 47.5.3 ([fddabeb](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/fddabeb523256428eb5bfc75fa258424c35994d6))
* **tiktok:** restore friends feed filters on 47.5.3 ([3cb795a](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/3cb795a2e529736345b2c62459de889d163a3db6))
* **tiktok:** restore history recording controls on 47.5.3 ([73ee0cc](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/73ee0cc785684f68c31feb880bef8384e79b9c8c))
* **tiktok:** restore inbox promos filter on 47.5.3 ([995eef7](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/995eef7ef371ae0c739b9b6a067c100fd06bfe31))
* **tiktok:** restore instant launch on 47.5.3 ([64f8dac](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/64f8dac624b171d7b17a402b3170f85065f35f99))
* **tiktok:** restore system font patch on 47.5.3 ([e89960a](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/e89960aa58fea9799908cd01761bcac156dd55fe))
* **tiktok:** restore top-left live button toggle on 47.5.3 ([f337af7](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/f337af7f12529df490b238642df6801b6347443d))
* **tiktok:** restore video fit mode on 47.5.3 ([5d49405](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/5d4940512d177597f23009a376a4769051b2ea25))
* **tiktok:** restore video interface declutter on 47.5.3 ([25b819d](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/25b819d11edc3a62f634b0d9ba2dfa112efa8e93))
* **universal:** exhaust onAdFailedToLoad overloads in AdLoadBlocker ([4df900e](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/4df900e03c60072b6c26ed96774e132f72ec7ff5))

### New Features

* **brave:** add opt-in AMOLED theme ([8246492](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/8246492f053a223f7780be8fba7318973ff61a3c))
* **brave:** default Custom theme surfaces to OLED black ([82c912d](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/82c912dae20d32451c228b3ce9afdb46b1564320))
* **brave:** rename AMOLED theme to customizable Custom Brave theme ([7105ab2](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/7105ab225f554f90b0b679bf32d83acc3ec263f3))
* **tiktok:** hide feed posts from chosen countries ([a6ce164](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/a6ce1640d57ecb138be5d3e8a829ec67cbc8d8e8))
* **tiktok:** hide feed posts from chosen creators ([46128b4](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/46128b4b3339e285a8156f54c07e3b9fc5d6f87d))
* **tiktok:** hide feed posts older than a chosen number of days ([88e7f3e](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/88e7f3e7c0e8e588860c30ba22f77000c9db9212))
* **tiktok:** hide feed posts that mention blocked keywords ([a329fd4](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/a329fd4f8c9bda6a053a62fb5be63dbe59f034d7))
* **tiktok:** hide feed posts with blocked hashtags ([c1a4140](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/c1a414045c26412469e814c5c957f1c7082c369f))
* **tiktok:** hide feed videos shorter or longer than a chosen length ([c73c8ff](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/c73c8ff87321711b2a46dbc05d5e947f6cfc3c08))
* **tiktok:** hide prompts asking to turn on notifications ([abc1807](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/abc18075f282d093ea65944648aae440d300f703))
* **tiktok:** load videos and live over regular HTTPS when QUIC is blocked ([5d532c9](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/5d532c95d0f499d77b3e0cd41748c3185a88165f))
* **tiktok:** show exact like, comment and view counts ([321a73b](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/321a73bdd33bf52fca7486abe57a3e9e1964f55a))
* **tiktok:** show poll results in comments without voting ([3cf9c5a](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/3cf9c5a827d4883a8acca32220c6682969bb0a7c))
* **tiktok:** update supported version to 47.5.3 ([df4f604](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/df4f604dfb814ad0a620bba5782eba87dc22fbfb))
* **universal:** add Bypass Play License patch ([507ed3d](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/507ed3db5cb3aaf503a395dc36ca0911038c5e30))
* **universal:** add Disable Root Checks patch ([ef43839](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/ef43839e65b9ebc1a731113c56e9a95840993edd))
* **universal:** add Override certificate pinning patch ([27a42b8](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/27a42b81b91129ffec4ccd211e02513f2cca5b64))
* **universal:** add Remove ads patch ([205332f](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/205332fa99bfc7bcf315174cee6b5d763be39869))
* **universal:** add Remove Pairip patch ([bcd4782](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/bcd47826648112a551146c576763009a8145ac38))
* **universal:** add Report Play Store as installer patch ([0fa0f7d](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/0fa0f7dbb6552a523aa8909e5f0d9c48c4b66436))
* **universal:** add Spoof signature patch ([7d69a6a](https://github.com/kveld9/kveld-morphe-patches/commit/7d69a6afe8e472b39e4a0cb2f3b02f10c4110623))

patches.name: Block Motion Sensors
patches.description: Stops sites from reading motion sensors to identify you.

patches.name: Block Popups & Rating Requests
patches.description: Blocks rating popups, review requests and promo dialogs.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.

options.description: Also blocks the shopping offers server. Turn off to keep it.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches.

patches.name: Clean Start Page
patches.description: Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.

options.description: Removes most-visited tiles for a blank start page.

patches.name: Custom Brave theme
patches.description: Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.

options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for primary backgrounds and base window chrome. Defaults to pure OLED black (#000000).
When enabled, cards, sheets, and dialogs share the primary background color. When disabled, elevated surfaces use the dedicated surface color below.
Opaque hexadecimal color for elevated surfaces such as cards, sheets, and dialogs. Defaults to OLED black (#000000); use #1e2029 for visible depth between tiers.
Opaque hexadecimal color applied to primary text labels. Defaults to Brave light slate ink (#f0f2ff).
Opaque hexadecimal color for interactive highlights, active switches, and links. Defaults to Brave purple-blue accent (#737ade).
Prevents Android 12+ wallpaper palette extraction from replacing dark surfaces. When disabled, dynamic system colors take precedence.
Opaque hexadecimal color for root window backgrounds in two-tier surface mode. Defaults to pure black (#000000).
Opaque hexadecimal color for preference item cards in Settings. Defaults to OLED black (#000000); use #1e2029 for visible depth between tiers.
Wraps settings and preference rows in rounded card shapes when two-tier surfaces are enabled.
When enabled, scales text brightness across primary, secondary, and disabled tiers using luminance ratios. When disabled, applies the text ink color uniformly.
Rewrites Android system neutral and surface container color roles in values-v31+ directories to theme colors.
Rewrites tonal luminance selectors in color resources to match custom background and container surfaces.
Rewrites hardcoded background and container fill colors inside vector drawables to match theme colors.

patches.name: Keep Tabs Open
patches.description: Stops Brave from minimizing your tabs in the background.

patches.name: Remove Extra Files
patches.description: Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.

options.description: Also deletes the WireGuard library. Brave VPN stops working.

patches.name: Remove Extra Languages
patches.description: Deletes unselected language packs.

options.description: Comma-separated language codes to keep (e.g. es, fr, de). English is always kept.

patches.name: Select Previous Tab on Close
patches.description: Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.

patches.name: Silence Promo Notifications
patches.description: Stops tips, reward promos and marketing notifications.

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screens
patches.description: Skips welcome, search choice and onboarding on fresh installs.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background wakeups and battery drain.

patches.name: Stop Text Sharing with System
patches.description: Stops sending page text to the Android capture service.

patches.name: Block App Hijacking
patches.description: Protects against other apps hijacking Gboard and removes debug tools.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Stops background metrics, event logging and crash reporting.

options.description: Also blocks Google ad servers. Turn off to keep them.

patches.name: Disable Cloud Backup
patches.description: Keeps keyboard data off Google Drive backups.

patches.name: Disable Play Services
patches.description: Runs without Google Play services. Also turns off inline Translate.

patches.name: Install a Copy
patches.description: Installs this Gboard next to the original one.

options.description: Suffix appended to the package name (e.g. clone).
Custom display name for the cloned app. Leave empty for default.

patches.name: Keyboard Settings
patches.description: Adds a settings screen inside Gboard: theme, vibration, clipboard and more.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Fully disconnects Gboard. Download dictionaries first.

patches.name: Remove Extra Files
patches.description: Deletes licenses, tutorial animations and junk.

patches.name: Remove Permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions you pick below.

options.description: Removes contact access (no contact name suggestions).
Removes microphone access (no voice dictation).
Removes photo access (no custom image themes).
Removes system dictionary access.
Separates work and personal profiles.

patches.name: Remove Translate Limit
patches.description: Removes the character limit for inline translation.

patches.name: Stop Background Sync
patches.description: Stops background downloads and sync to save battery.

patches.name: Stop Remote Updates
patches.description: Stops Google from changing settings remotely.

patches.name: Allow Screenshots
patches.description: Removes screenshot and screen recording blocking.

patches.name: Always Show Publish Date
patches.description: Shows the upload date on all videos.

patches.name: Auto-Pause First Video
patches.description: Pauses the first video on launch so it plays without lag.

patches.name: Battery & Resource Saver
patches.description: Stops 3D ad sensors and aggressive video preloading to save battery and data.

patches.name: Block P2P Video Relay
patches.description: Stops your device from uploading videos to other users.

patches.name: Block Popups & Prompts
patches.description: Blocks popups, nags and promo dialogs across the app.

options.description: Suppresses 'Follow your friends' modals, 'Find contacts' Friends tab sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, and 'Security checkup 2SV' upsells.
Stops prompts asking you to turn on notifications.
Disables personalized sticker suggestion popups and typing recommendations in direct messages.

Suppresses repetitive PopLayer prompts including favorites collection guides, launcher shortcut dialogs, repost newbie sheets, STEM feed prompts, campus education sheets, creator inbox guides, app review dialogs, marketing opt-ins, FYP surveys, CapCut/Lemon8 upsells, profile visitor prompts, and story intro sheets.
Disables floating live stream preview teasers and popup windows from appearing over the video feed.
Suppresses direct message streak expiration warning banners and inline urgency reminders.
Suppresses the automatic 'Share to' and friend suggestions bottom sheet that pops up after finishing a download.
Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.
Skips the first-launch intro, tutorials and consent screens.
Bypasses and clears sensitive content warnings, graphic media blur overlays, and age gates on feed videos.

patches.name: Block Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog tracking, crash monitors, and analytics.

patches.name: Block Trackers (Setup)
patches.description: Removes tracking permissions and disables telemetry components.

patches.name: Bypass Mandatory Login
patches.description: Lets you browse videos and feeds without creating an account or logging in.

patches.name: Camera & Microphone Indicator
patches.description: Shows a corner mark while TikTok holds camera/mic open.

patches.name: Clean Share Links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from shared links.

options.description: Custom hostname to replace in shared links (e.g. 'vxtiktok.com', 'tiktxk.com', or empty to keep original host).

patches.name: Comment Customizer
patches.description: Takes control of comments: sort, copy, translate and hide clutter.

options.description: Unlocks TikTok's native comment sorting menu (Hot, Newest, Creator only, With media) across all posts.
Prevents silent comment publishing drops when the top-page screen context is detached or null.
Copies only the comment text without prepending the author username.
Removes the horizontal bar of suggested quick emojis displayed above the comment input box.
Hides the quick action buttons (photo, emoji, and mention) inside the comment input bar.
Hides surveys, opinion questionnaires, and feedback cards embedded within comment lists.
Removes profile photo story rings from avatars in the comment section.
Forces the native voice comment recording button in comment input bars, bypassing regional rollout restrictions and remote server blocks.
Suppresses promotional brand surprise animation popups and commercial campaign effects when loading comments or publishing.
Automatically expands community-flagged comments inline as normal comments, without showing the warning banner or requiring a tap.
Shows poll results in comments without voting first.
Automatically translates comments into your preferred language using TikTok's native translation engine.

Comma-separated ISO 639 codes (e.g. 'en,es,zh') whose comments keep their original text. Applies on top of TikTok's native do-not-translate list and only matters when Auto-Translate Comments is enabled.

patches.name: Custom Share Sheet
patches.description: Lets you hide share menu entries you do not use.

options.description: Hides WhatsApp and WhatsApp Status from the share sheet.
Hides Instagram and Instagram Stories from the share sheet.
Hides Facebook, Facebook Stories, and Messenger from the share sheet.
Hides Telegram from the share sheet.
Hides X (Twitter) from the share sheet.
Hides Snapchat from the share sheet.
Hides Reddit and Discord from the share sheet.
Hides SMS and Google Messages from the share sheet.
Hides regional and secondary third-party social apps (Line, Kakao, Viber, VK, Lemon8, etc.).
Hides the native Repost button from the share sheet. Note: disabling this also disables the long-press to repost gesture.
Hides the QR code sharing button from the share sheet.
Hides the Copy link button from the share sheet.
Hides the system share dialog ('More') button from the share sheet.
Hides the top row of direct message friend and contact avatars ('Send to') in the share sheet.
Removes the horizontal row of suggested quick emojis from the direct share panel.
Removes the 'Send to new group' button and hint from the direct share panel.
Hides the commercial Promote action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the recommendation explanation action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Create group action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Add to Story action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the sticker creation tool from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Duet action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Stitch action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Use this effect entry from the share sheet.
Hides the Picture-in-Picture floating player action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Clear display mode action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the background audio playback action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides Live wallpaper and GIF creation actions from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the 'Not interested' action from the bottom utilities row.
Hides the Report action from the bottom utilities row.

patches.name: Customize Search
patches.description: Customizes search suggestions, live recommendations, and autoplay.

options.description: Removes suggested searches and 'You may like' cards from search discovery.
Removes popular live stream cards from search discovery.
Stops videos and photos from playing automatically in search results.
Forces non-personalized search results.
Enables search within the Live drawer.

patches.name: Declutter Direct Messages
patches.description: Cleans up chat and DM screens by hiding extra buttons.

options.description: Removes the camera icon next to chats in the direct messages conversation list.
Removes the phone receiver (voice/video call) button from the direct message chat header.
Removes the quick forward/share arrow button displayed next to messages and shared videos.
Removes the reaction bar and streak mascot banner displayed above the text input bar.
Removes the camera button located to the left of the direct message text input field.
Removes the photo gallery button located inside the right side of the text input field.
Removes the stickers and emoji button located inside the right side of the text input field.
Removes the audio recording/microphone button located inside the right side of the text input field.
Removes the 'Try effect' camera button shown on shared videos that use an effect in direct messages.
Removes the automatic 'Tap a sticker to reply' suggestion panel and the typing-triggered sticker/GIF strip above the input bar. The manual sticker reply button keeps working.

patches.name: Declutter Navigation Bar
patches.description: Removes extra tabs and buttons from navigation bars.

options.description: Removes the TikTok Shop / Mall navigation tab and indicator from navigation bars. Disable if you want to keep access to your purchases and orders while still hiding video product tags.
Removes the Nearby (local city or region) feed tab from the top navigation feed strip.
Removes the Community (Explore) tab from the top navigation feed strip and bottom bar.
Removes the top-left LIVE broadcast button and tab entry point from the top navigation bar.
Removes the search suggestion pill and trending bar ('Search · <keyword>') from the bottom of feed videos.
Removes the central '+' create / publish content button from the bottom navigation bar.
Prevents friend profile pictures from replacing the Friends icon on the bottom navigation bar and keeps the standard icon visible.
Removes the unread message counter badge and notification red dot from the bottom Messages (Inbox) tab.

patches.name: Declutter Video Interface
patches.description: Cleans up the buttons and overlays on top of videos.

options.description: Hides the repost and shared-by pill badge ('Shared by' / 'Reposted') above creator details on feed videos.
Hides video descriptions, captions, and hashtags across feed videos while keeping creator and author title intact.
Hides the plus (+) follow badge on creator profile avatars in the feed and disables its touch interaction.
Removes creator profile photo story rings from feed videos, ensuring avatar photos remain clean without blue story rings.
Hides the playlist indicator bar displayed above the bottom navigation when a video is part of a playlist.
Hides the bookmark/favorite save button on the right-side action rail of feed videos.
Hides the rotating vinyl music album cover disc at the bottom right corner of feed videos.
Hides the floating 'Full screen' landscape orientation button overlay on horizontal feed videos.
Hides the 'Not interested' / 'Interested' feedback pills above the bottom navigation on feed videos.
Disables the double tap gesture to like videos in the feed, preventing accidental likes while scrolling or pausing. Videos can still be liked using the like button.
Removes the LIVE ring on avatars and keeps taps on the profile.
Prevents holding the Like button on feed videos from opening the Repost action panel. Turns off long-press actions like repost, quick DM and quick emoji.
Prevents holding the Share button on feed videos from opening the quick share recent contacts tray. Turns off long-press actions like repost, quick DM and quick emoji.
Prevents holding the Comment button on feed videos from opening the quick reaction emojis picker. Turns off long-press actions like repost, quick DM and quick emoji.
Action when long pressing feed video body: 'nothing' (default, suppresses menu/repost), 'comments' (opens comments), 'copyLink' (copies link to clipboard), or 'saveSound' (favorites/saves audio).

patches.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches.description: Blocks access to your contacts, location, apps and sensors.

patches.name: Disable History Recording
patches.description: Prevents TikTok from recording your watch history and search queries.

options.description: Prevents viewed videos from being recorded in account watch history, playback duration stores, and local history caches.
Prevents search queries and keywords from being recorded in local history, databases, and analytics stores.

patches.name: Disable Live Gift Effects
patches.description: Disables 3D gift animations in live streams to prevent frame drops.

patches.name: Disable On-Device AI
patches.description: Turns off on-device AI, the chatbot and AI search.

patches.name: Disable Push Notifications
patches.description: Stops background push notifications.

patches.name: Disable QUIC
patches.description: Loads videos, uploads, and live connections over standard HTTPS instead of QUIC.

patches.name: Download Without Watermark
patches.description: Unlocks downloading and saves videos without watermarks.

options.description: Saves clean videos without watermark overlays.
Select download quality: 'high', 'medium', 'low', or a resolution ceiling (e.g. 1080, 720).

patches.name: Enable Profile Banner
patches.description: Unlocks the profile banner and its editing tools.

patches.name: Feed Ads & Content Filter
patches.description: Filters ads, shopping tags, live cards, and clutter from your feed.

options.description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You, Following, and Search feeds.

Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You and Following feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), community/topic cards, post-video surveys and evaluation questionnaires, mini-drama paywalls, and in-feed search recommendations.
Removes shopping cart tags, product showcase badges, and commercial anchors from FYP and Following feed videos.
Removes live stream broadcast cards and live recommendations from the For You and Following feeds.
Filters and skips videos tagged with native AI-generated metadata, C2PA content credentials, or creator AI disclosure tags across the For You, Following, and Friends feeds.
Filters previously watched videos from incoming For You feed batches.
Hide videos with fewer views than this. 0 disables the minimum.
Hide videos with more views than this. 0 disables the maximum.
Hide videos with fewer likes than this. 0 disables the minimum.
Hide videos with more likes than this. 0 disables the maximum.
Hide posts from these creators. Comma-separated usernames, for example: user1,user2.
Hide posts with any of these hashtags. Comma-separated, for example: fyp,ad.
Hide posts whose caption contains any of these words. Comma-separated, for example: giveaway,crypto.
Hide posts published from these countries. Comma-separated two-letter country codes, for example: US,BR.
Hide posts older than this many days. 0 disables it.
Hide videos shorter than this many seconds. 0 disables it.
Hide videos longer than this many seconds. 0 disables it.
Removes story posts from the For You feed.
Removes photo-mode posts from the For You feed.

patches.name: Force Auto-Scroll
patches.description: Enables native auto-scrolling to the next video.

patches.name: Friends & Suggestions Filter
patches.description: Keeps the Friends feed strictly mutual and hides suggested accounts across the app.

options.description: The Friends feed only shows people you both follow.
Removes suggested friend card insertions, recommended user horizontal lists, and swipe cards from the Friends feed.
Removes suggested-account cards from profile headers and inbox surfaces.

patches.name: Hide Inbox Promos & Alerts
patches.description: Hides promo banners, streak cards and suggestions in your inbox.

options.description: Hides header banners including the streak pet / mascot, event announcements, top notice banners, and phone link prompts.
Hides user recommendation cards (Chat with contacts / Find and chat with them), suggested accounts, and mutual friends modules in the chatlist.
Hides UI migration tooltips (e.g. New followers has moved), bulletin board guide banners, and Shop migration notices.

patches.name: Hide Inbox Story Tray
patches.description: Hides the stories and status tray at the top of the inbox.

options.description: Hides only suggested and non-followed story circles in the inbox tray, preserving followed stories and preventing autoplay into suggested users.

patches.name: In-App Browser Privacy Guard
patches.description: Opens web links in your browser and blocks tracking in the remaining web views.

patches.name: Instant Launch
patches.description: Opens the app immediately without splash screens or ad delays.

patches.name: Login Compatibility Fix
patches.description: Restores Google and Spotify sign-in on modified app builds.

options.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching by forcing fallback to Web-based OAuth when Google Play Services rejects the modified APK signature.
Restores 'Add to Spotify' after signing in on the web.

patches.name: Offline Video Limit
patches.description: Customizes the maximum number of videos saved for offline viewing.

options.description: Maximum number of offline videos that can be cached for offline playback (default: 1000).

patches.name: Playback & Display Governor
patches.description: Limits playback resolution and HDR to save battery, and locks the screen refresh rate.

options.description: Caps video playback resolution to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data.
Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
Drops ByteVC2 renditions from playback bitrate lists when an H.264 or ByteVC1 alternative exists, so videos use the hardware decoder instead of TikTok's CPU-bound ByteVC2 software decoder.

When the ladder's lowest video stream exceeds the device hardware decoder capability (queried via MediaCodecList), drops video streams and keeps audio-only instead of entering decoder-reject retry loops that freeze the device.
Plays standard video instead of HDR. Keeps screen brightness normal.
Forces TikTok to run at peak display refresh rate (120Hz/90Hz/60Hz) and neutralizes video playback framerate downclocking routines.
Select target display refresh rate: max (display peak rate), 120 (120 Hz), 90 (90 Hz), or 60 (60 Hz). Clamped automatically to display maximum.

options.description: Two-letter ISO country code for SIM and network country spoofing (e.g. 'CH', 'US', 'JP', 'GB').
5-6 digit MCC+MNC code (e.g. '22801' for Switzerland/Swisscom) used to spoof TelephonyManager operator queries and CellIdentity MCC/MNC reads. Empty keeps stock operator values.
Display name reported for SIM/network operator queries (e.g. 'Swisscom'). Empty keeps the stock operator name.

patches.name: Strip Sensitive Permissions
patches.description: Removes sensitive hardware, sensor, and tracking permissions.

options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+). Notification channels cannot dispatch push alerts.
Remove CAMERA permission. WARNING: Breaks camera recording, photo capturing, QR scanning, LIVE broadcasting, and video creation.
Remove RECORD_AUDIO, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA permissions. WARNING: Breaks video voice recording, LIVE audio broadcasting, audio comments, and voice/video calling.

Remove external storage (READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION). WARNING: Breaks local gallery picker, drafts, and video/photo saving.

Remove BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, and BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE permissions. WARNING: Breaks Bluetooth audio accessories, wireless headphones low-latency sync, Cast devices, and external remote controls.
Remove NFC permission. WARNING: Disables NFC tag interactions and NFC-based hardware authentication tokens.
Remove USE_BIOMETRIC and USE_FINGERPRINT permissions. WARNING: Breaks fingerprint/face biometric unlocking, passkeys, and biometric payment authorization.

Remove generic FOREGROUND_SERVICE and specialized types (DATA_SYNC, MEDIA_PLAYBACK, MEDIA_PROJECTION, PHONE_CALL). WARNING: HIGH RISK. Breaks background video uploads, offline caching, media playback notification services, screen sharing, and VoIP calls in background.
Remove SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission. WARNING: Breaks Picture-in-Picture overlay window outside the app, floating mini-player, and overlay notification heads.
Remove WAKE_LOCK permission. WARNING: Device CPU may sleep during media playback or long video uploads/downloads when screen turns off, suspending progress.
Remove DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE and DETECT_SCREEN_RECORDING permissions to neutralize system-level capture callbacks.

Remove MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, MANAGE_OWN_CALLS, REORDER_TASKS, SET_WALLPAPER, and USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT permissions. WARNING: Breaks volume adjustments, alarm priority intents, and live wallpaper export. Haptic vibration is always kept because TikTok crashes without it.
Remove OEM attribution, launcher badges, AICore bindings, and proprietary TikTok internal IPC permissions.
Remove Google C2DM/FCM and Amazon ADM push receiver permissions. WARNING: Breaks push notification delivery.
Remove Google Play in-app billing permission (com.android.vending.BILLING). WARNING: Breaks coin purchases and in-app transactions.

patches.name: Use System Font
patches.description: Uses the system font instead of bundled TikTok fonts.

patches.name: Video Fit Mode
patches.description: Lets you choose between fitting the whole video or filling the screen.

options.description: Choose 'fit' to see the whole video or 'fill' to crop and fill the screen.
